name: GalaxyCon San Jose
blurb: A three-day San Jose festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, with celebrities, voice actors, comic creators, cosplayers and fan groups at the McEnery Convention Center.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON SAN JOSE ... AUGUST 20-22, 2027 ... We look forward to seeing you August 20-22, 2027 at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center'

notes: Succeeds SiliCon/Silicon Valley Comic Con at the same venue per the discovery note; confirmed directly from the con's own site (not from that note). Guest cards show only name + attendance days, so Known for is left blank throughout. Card #20's visible caption literally reads 'Pro Wrestlers Coming Soon' (a category placeholder, even though its image file is oddly named after wrestler Gangrel) so it is skipped rather than assumed confirmed. Two Authentication cards (JSA, Agents of Slabs) are vendor services, not individual guests, and are excluded, matching galaxycon-raleigh. A few guest names (e.g. Marv Wolfman, Bob Layton) sit behind image files named for other people (reused/mislabeled assets on GalaxyCon's own site) — the displayed name text is what's used in each case. Cover uses the San Jose wordmark logo; the homepage's other images are the shared 11-city promo, a generic galaxy background, a cosplay cutout prop, a fan's photo-op snapshot, and a ticket-sale banner, none of which are edition-specific key art.
